# Kay v2 Reference (for humans & coding agents)

> Kay v2 is a Bun-native TSX web framework with zero-directive automatic islands, `.value` fine-grained signals, flat-string SSR, unified Standard-Schema actions, single-binary `--compile`, and a composable `KayPlugin` API.

## Core Rules (everything fits on one page)

- **Imports**: `@kayjs/kay` (signals, `Head`, `Suspense`, `Catch`, `Region`, `ConsentGate`, `createContext`, `provideContext`, `useContext`, `useId`, `useAction`), `@kayjs/kay/server` (`action`, `getActionError`, `notFound`, `defineEnv`, `nodeEnv`, `raw`, `esc`, `escAttr`, `escJson` (JSON text for a `<script>`), `getClientIp`, `isHttpsRequest`, `isTrustedOrigin`, `verifyOrigin`, `safeRedirect`, `safeEqual` (constant-time secret compare), `wantsJson`, `readStringFields` (a body's string fields, on a null-prototype record), `validateSchema`, `validateSchemaSync`, `formatSchemaIssues`, `formatIssuePath`, route types, `createServer({ root })` to run a built app inside another program), `@kayjs/kay/config` (`defineConfig`, `definePlugin`, `serviceKey`, `isInside(dir, target, { orSame })`, plugin types), `@kayjs/kay/test` (`testApp`, `testBrowser`). A bare `kay` import fails the compile (`kay upgrade` rewrites them); `@kayjs/kay/internal/*` is compiler output, outside semver.
- **Standard TSX & compiler guardrails**: `.tsx` files with `jsxImportSource: "@kayjs/kay"`. Use `class` or `className` (never both). Standard `.map()` (with `key={...}`), `&&`, ternaries, `{...spread}`, SVG elements, style strings or objects (`style={{ color: 'red' }}`), and CSS / `*.module.css` imports work natively. Compiler/runtime refuse common React/Solid/Astro habits: `innerHTML={html}` takes a string or `raw(html)` (never `{ __html }`, never `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, never on void elements or with children); events are camelCase DOM names (`onClick`, `onDblClick`, `onKeyDown` — never lowercase `onclick`, `on:click`, `onDoubleClick`, `*Capture`, string handlers, or render-time assignments); `ref` is always a callback `ref={el => ...}` (never `{ current }`); SVG attrs use kebab-case (`stroke-width`, `fill-opacity`); entities in string attrs and props decode like text (`title="a &amp; b"` is `a & b`; an `innerHTML` string stays as written); use `value`/`checked` (not `defaultValue`/`defaultChecked`) and boolean `{false}` (not `"false"`); no `client:*`/`use:*`/`class:list`/`set:html` directives and no `'use client'`/`'use server'`; no Promises, functions, signals, or plain objects in JSX text/attrs. Spreads drop `on*`, `innerHTML`, `srcdoc`, and `javascript:`/`vbscript:` URLs.
- **Signals, Context & IDs (`@kayjs/kay`)**: `const count = signal(0)` (`.value` read/write, `.peek()` untracked), `computed(() => ...)`, `effect(() => ...)` (return cleanup, never `async`; skipped while an island renders on the server, so derive values with `computed`; a local signal read without `.value` in JSX, an `if`/ternary/loop test or `!`, and `const { value } = count`, fail compile), `batch(() => ...)`, `untrack(() => ...)`, `root(dispose => ...)`, `onMount(() => ...)` (runs after DOM attach; return cleanup), `onCleanup(() => ...)`, `getOwner()`, `selector(() => id.value)` (O(1) selection), `store(obj)` + `snapshot(s)`. Context: `const Ctx = createContext(defaultValue)`, `<Ctx.Provider value={v}>` or `provideContext(Ctx, v, fn)`, `useContext(Ctx)`. Deterministic hydration-safe IDs: `useId(prefix = 'k')` (scoped per island or SSR request). To let a child mutate parent state, pass the signal directly (`<Modal open={isOpen} />`).
- **Reactive props**: Destructuring props (`function Badge({ count = 0, ...rest }: Props)`) stays reactive in client components, and a default beyond a literal or a name (`items = []`, `id = useId()`) runs once per call; server-rendered children inside islands are preserved via `<kay-slot>`.
- **Automatic islands**: Any component using reactive primitives (`signal`, `computed`, `effect`, `onMount`, `store`, `selector`), DOM `on*` handlers/`ref`, or imported reactive module state becomes an island automatically, decided per component: a static export beside an island stays static, a component that needs the browser is an island of its own wherever server code renders it as a tag, same file included (the page around it stays static; its chunk keeps only the code of the file it reaches, so an async page importing server code can render a local widget; its props cross the island boundary), a same-file helper that needs the browser makes each component calling it an island, and a primitive called at a file's top level makes every component of it one. Control hydration per call site with `$hydrate="load" | "visible" | "idle" | "interaction" | "media(...)" | "client"`, or the component file's default `export const hydrate = 'visible'` (unknown modes and `$hydrate` on non-islands fail compile); the loader carries only the strategies the app's islands can use, and a page modulepreloads its eager islands with every chunk they and the runtime import (a streamed page its route's eager islands only). `<Head>`/`<Suspense>` in an island fail compile (`<Catch>` works in both); an island reading a context provided outside it throws in SSR (pass the value as a prop); server children handed to an island render before it, in the page's scope. Hydration steps over a node an extension injected and redraws a part whose tag differs from the server's and drops the server rows past a list's last row, in production too (dev also warns). Island props crossing the server boundary must be serializable (JSON primitives + `Date`, `Map`, `Set`, `URL`, `RegExp` — functions, signals and JSX in a prop other than `children` are refused; only a page whose props hold one of those classes loads, and preloads, the small file that revives them); an `on*` function passed from server code to a component that is not an island fails build and check too, since it would never run. A browser global (`window`, `document`, `localStorage`, ...) read while a component renders or its module loads warns, since the server has none: read it in `onMount()`, an effect or a handler, or behind `typeof window !== 'undefined'`. Islands cannot import server-only modules (`bun:sqlite`, `node:*`, `@kayjs/kay/server`) or read `process.env` other than `process.env.PUBLIC_*` (inlined at build time); action files are stubbed on the client (non-action exports from them cannot be imported by islands).
- **Routes (`src/routes/`)**:
  - `export default async function Page({ params, locals, url })`: strictly server-only (`0 KB` JS; cannot use signals/handlers directly).
  - Sync `export default function Page({ data, params, locals, url }: PageProps<typeof load>)`: static or auto-island; optional `export async function load(ctx)` runs server-only and returns data, `notFound()` (from `@kayjs/kay/server` — return or throw to render `_404.tsx` with HTTP `404`), or a `Response` (e.g. redirect).
  - Special files: `_layout.tsx` (nested outer→inner, receives `{ children, params, locals, url }`, server-only), `_middleware.ts` (`(ctx, next) => Response`, outer→inner), `_error.tsx` (receives `{ error }`, server-only, wrapped in root layout), `_404.tsx` (server-only, wrapped in root layout, also emitted as `404.html` in `--static`); each needs a default export. Any other file under `src/routes/` must export a page, a method handler or an action (guarded by its folder's `_middleware.ts`), else `kay build`/`kay check` fail: prefix helpers or their folder with `_`.
  - Params: `[slug].tsx` → `params.slug`; `[...path].tsx` → `params.path` (segments joined by `/`). Params arrive percent-decoded; a segment holding an encoded `/`, `\` or NUL, or a `.`/`..` segment, matches no dynamic route (404), so a param is safe to join into a path; static pages, `public/` files and `kay start --static` decode by the same rule (`/a%2fb.txt` never serves `a/b.txt`).
  - API routes: `.ts` files exporting `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE` receiving `RequestContext` (`request`, `url`, `params`, `cookies`, `locals`, `ip`, `region`, `json()`, `text()`, `redirect()`, `deny()`). Optional `export const csrf = false` opts out of origin checks (e.g. webhooks/bearer APIs).
  - Prerendering: `export const prerender = true` (+ `export function paths() { return ['/posts/a'] }` required for dynamic routes, and for every dynamic page under `--static`, or `kay build` fails; unlisted params return `404`). Skipped in `kay dev`.
- **Streaming & Head**: `<Head><title>...</title></Head>` (innermost `<title>` wins); `<Suspense fallback={<p>Loading</p>} error={<p>Failed</p>}><AsyncComp /></Suspense>` streams resolved HTML inline with 0 KB external JS (takes exactly one child; an async component anywhere but as the only child of `<Suspense>` fails build and check, even inside an async page; nested boundaries supported; times out after `streamTimeout`, default `30000` ms; errors also fire `onError`). `<Catch fallback={<p>Failed</p> | (error, retry) => ...}>` renders its fallback in place of children that throw or an awaited child that rejects, on the server (firing `onError`; nothing streams) and in an island, where it also catches a child effect's later throw and `retry()` renders the children again; errors thrown by event handlers are not caught.
- **Regions** (`@kayjs/spa`, `regions()`): `<Region name="pane" as="section" ...attrs>children</Region>` (from `@kayjs/kay`, server-only like `Head`) renders `<div data-kay-region="pane">`; its children are read only when the page or the requested region needs them. `<a href data-kay-target="pane">` swaps that region in place: the browser sends `x-kay-region: pane`, the server answers with the region's inner HTML alone (no layouts, no document; `ctx.region` tells `load()` which, `vary: x-kay-region`), history is pushed and back/forward re-fetch it, focus moves to the region, its `aria-label` is announced, `aria-busy="true"` is set after 150 ms and cleared on swap or failure. Add `data-kay-append` and the response is appended and the clicked link removed (Load more; the history entry is replaced, not pushed). `<form method="get" data-kay-target="results">` swaps on submit; with `data-kay-live` also on input (debounced 200 ms; one history entry per typing burst, a 1 s pause ends it). `data-kay-sync="q icon"` on a link, or on an input/select (its `name`), copies those params of the current URL after every swap so links outside the region stay in step. A link inside `[data-kay-prefetch]` prefetches its region on hover/focus through the cache `spa()` shares. A region may sit inside another (give each its own name): asking for the inner one renders it alone (header `x-kay-region: results/sets`, the path outermost first, which the client computes), asking for the outer renders it with a fresh inner, and an outer swap drops in-flight fetches of the regions inside it. Every region swap also sets `document.title` from the page's `<Head><title>` at that URL (title template applied; the server sends it in `x-kay-title`), and back/forward restore it. `await refreshRegion(name)` from `@kayjs/spa/regions` redraws a region of the current address from script (after a background `fetch` to an action): no history entry, focus left alone, prefetch cache skipped, `kay:region` fired; it rejects when the page has no such region, the fetch fails or the answer lacks it. `<form method="post" data-kay-target="x">` posts through fetch, follows the redirect and swaps region x (without JS it posts normally); empty fields are dropped from a GET form's URL. A swap runs in a view transition where supported and not under reduced motion; each history entry remembers the window's and the regions' scroll, a pushed swap resets the region's own scroll unless it has `data-kay-keep-scroll="<key>"`; links to the new URL get `aria-current="page"`; a `#hash` link on the page scrolls with no fetch. The regions client ships only on routes whose tree renders a `<Region>`. Without JS, or when a fetch fails or the response lacks the region, the link loads the whole page. Mistakes: `<Region>` without `name`, `data-kay-target` off `<a>`/`<form>`, `data-kay-live` on a non-GET form, `data-kay-append`/`data-kay-live` without their target, a region inside a region of the same name (compile errors); a target naming no `<Region>` in `src/` (`kay check`); two regions of one name, a requested region the route does not render (runtime throws).
- **Actions (`@kayjs/kay/server` & `useAction` from `@kayjs/kay`)**: `export const fn = action(standardSchema, async (input, ctx) => ..., options?)` or `action(async (ctx) => ...)` — must be a top-level named export so Kay can assign a URL. Works as zero-JS `<form action={fn} method="post">` (array fields auto-coerced from checkboxes/multi-selects; validation failures set an `HttpOnly` flash cookie readable via `getActionError(ctx.locals)` with sensitive fields stripped or `flashFields` allowlisted and `303` redirect to trusted Referer) and as typed island RPC `const res = await fn(data)` (always resolves to `{ ok: true, data }` or `{ ok: false, status, error, fieldErrors?, issues? }`; accepts `FormData` for files; redirects navigate the page). In islands, `const form = useAction(fn, { reset?, onSuccess?, onError? })` returns `{ pending, error, fieldErrors, data, action, onSubmit, submit, reset }` (`pending`/`error`/`fieldErrors`/`data` are `ReadonlySignal`s; wire `<form action={form.action} method="post" onSubmit={form.onSubmit}>` for progressive enhancement). A route, `load()`, middleware or another action may also call it: it runs in that request, schema and folder `_middleware.ts` included, and resolves to the same result; called outside a request it throws. Server code is stripped from client bundles; CSRF `Origin`/`Sec-Fetch-Site` is checked before middleware and body parsing; folder `_middleware.ts` runs before the handler. `ctx` provides `redirect()` and `deny(status, message, fieldErrors?)`.
- **Config, Security & Server Helpers (`kay.config.ts`, `@kayjs/kay/config`, `@kayjs/kay/server`)**: `defineConfig({ lang, port, routesDir, outDir, publicDir, assetPrefix, security, trustedOrigins, trustProxy, maxRequestBodySize, streamTimeout, consent, compliance, compress, onError, plugins })`. Default security headers (`security: false` to disable, or override `csp`, `hsts`, `frameOptions`, `referrerPolicy`, `contentTypeOptions`) attach strict `DEFAULT_CSP` (style attributes allowed) with automatic SHA-256 hashes for island/Suspense styles, the app's own `<style>` blocks and stream scripts, plus `HSTS` on HTTPS requests. `trustProxy: true | number` trusts that many right-most proxy hops for `X-Forwarded-*`. `maxRequestBodySize` defaults to `1 MiB`. `@kayjs/kay/server` also exports `defineEnv(standardSchema)` (validates env vars at startup), `nodeEnv()` (safe in `--compile`), HTML escaping (`raw`, `esc`, `escAttr`), HTTP security helpers (`getClientIp`, `isHttpsRequest`, `isTrustedOrigin`, `verifyOrigin`, and `safeRedirect(target, fallback = '/')`, which returns the trimmed target only when it is a path on this site, refusing absolute and protocol-relative URLs, backslashes and control characters, and which `@kayjs/auth` and the consent endpoint use), and Standard Schema helpers (`validateSchema`, `validateSchemaSync`, `formatSchemaIssues`, `formatIssuePath`).
- **French web law & Consent (RGPD, CNIL, RGAA, LCEN — 0 B client JS)**: `kay check` and production `kay build` emit actionable warnings (never hard errors): `rgaa/img-alt` (`<img>` without `alt`), `rgaa/form-label` (unlabelled `<input>`/`<select>`/`<textarea>`), `rgaa/accessible-name` (empty or icon-only `<button>`/`<a>`), `rgpd/third-party-url` (third-party `<script src>`, `<link rel="stylesheet|preload|preconnect|dns-prefetch">`, `<iframe src>`, and CSS `@import`/`url(...)` outside `<ConsentGate>` or `site`), `lcen/legal-notice` (page app missing `/mentions-legales` or `/legal`), and `rgaa/accessibility-statement` (when `compliance: { publicBody: true }`, missing `/accessibilite`). Silence explicitly per rule via `compliance: { ignore: [...], legalNotice?: string | false, publicBody?: boolean }` in `kay.config.ts`, or `// kay-ignore <rule>` / `/* kay-ignore <rule> */` / `// kay-ignore-file <rule>`. One-declaration consent: configure `consent: { categories: ['analytics', 'media'], cookieName?: 'kay_consent', maxAge?: 15552000, endpoint?: '/_kay/consent' }` in `kay.config.ts` — Kay wires a CSRF-protected `POST /_kay/consent` endpoint (works with zero-JS HTML `<form method="post" action="/_kay/consent">` via `action="accept-all"|"reject-all"` or category checkboxes -> `303`, and JSON -> `200`), exposes `ctx.consent` (`decided`, `categories`, `has(cat)`, `all()`), refuses `ctx.cookies.set(name, val, { category })` before consent is granted, and exports server-only `<ConsentGate category="media" fallback={...}>` (0 KB browser JS, refused inside islands).
- **Page changes (plain multi-page navigation, 0 B of JS)**: every page carries inline, CSP-hashed `@view-transition { navigation: auto }` (inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`) and a `<script type="speculationrules">` prefetching same-origin links on hover (`eagerness: moderate`); never links to another origin, `/_kay/*` (actions included), `[download]`, `[rel~=nofollow]`, nor a link or ancestor with `data-kay-no-prefetch`. Name an element that stays still with CSS `view-transition-name`. `defineConfig({ navigation: { viewTransitions?: boolean (true), prefetch?: 'conservative' | 'moderate' | 'eager' | false ('moderate'), prerender?: 'conservative' | 'moderate' | 'eager' | boolean (false; true is 'moderate'; it runs `load()` of pages nobody opens) } })`; a bad value throws `kay: navigation.<key> is ...`. `data-kay-keep-scroll="<key>"` on a scrolling element keeps its `scrollTop` across page loads (restored before first paint when the next page has the same key; per history entry on back/forward/reload; `sessionStorage` blocked = no-op): the page gets one inline hashed script at the end of `<body>` only when it uses the attribute. The key is a literal string without `"<>&` (compile error otherwise, also for a nested panel of the same key); the same key on two elements of one rendered page throws `kay: data-kay-keep-scroll="..." is on two elements of one page`. `@kayjs/spa` keeps the same attribute across its swaps.
- **Static files & CSS**: Files in `public/` are served at `/` with ETag/`304` (and `Cache-Control: no-cache` in `kay dev`; embedded in `--static` and `--compile`); prerendered pages and hashed assets answer an ETag, a `304` and a `HEAD` length too. `kay build` compresses hashed assets, `public/` files and prerendered pages of 256 B or more into `.br` and `.gz` files beside them, kept when smaller, and the server sends those as they are; it compresses on the fly (zstd, gzip) only what has none, such as pages rendered per request. A `public/x.css.br` the app ships is kept and sent as `x.css` in brotli. `kay start` on a `--static` export lists its files at startup (`x` serves `x.html` or `x/index.html`, a miss `404.html`), re-lists them when one changes in place, and loads a new export with no restart. Import `.css` or `*.module.css` directly from any component or layout.
- **CLI**: `kay new <dir> [--template minimal|fullstack|blog|app] [--force]` (its `AGENTS.md` points agents at this file, installed at `node_modules/@kayjs/kay/llms.txt`), `kay check [dir] [--no-typecheck] [--json] [--strict]` (every compiler mistake of a file, each at its `file:line:col: error:`, warnings as `file:line:col: warning:`; `--json` prints `{ ok, checkedFiles, typecheck, errors, warnings }` with `file`/`line`/`col`/`severity`/`message`, `typecheck` being `{ ran: true, tool }` or `{ ran: false, reason }` (no tsconfig, `--no-typecheck`, no checker), which the summary line also names; `--strict` exits 1 on a warning; `kay build` refuses the same mistakes, without the typecheck; a plugin `check(ctx)` reports with `ctx.error()` or `ctx.warn()`), `kay inspect [dir] [--json]` (fast static report of routes, islands with interactivity `reason` and `hydrate` mode, actions with URLs and guarding `_middleware.ts`, and active plugins in resolved order without bundling; `--json` prints `{ routes, islands, actions, plugins }`), `kay dev [dir] [--port 3000] [--host [addr]]` (loopback `127.0.0.1` default; a `kay.config.ts` that fails to load stops it naming `kay.config.ts:<line>:<col>: <error>`; the app runs in a child process behind the port: a save rebuilds in it, an edit to `kay.config.ts` or a local file it imports, or the child passing 2 GB after a rebuild, starts a fresh one (module and plugin memory reset, requests wait, the reload stream stays open); a crash answers with its exit and stderr until the next save; an edited `public/` file reloads with no rebuild), `kay build [dir] [--static] [--compile [out]] [--analyze] [--json] [--max-js <size>]` (`--analyze` lists each route's eager JS (the runtime a plugin's `clientEntry` puts on every page included), CSS, fonts and first load (what a first visit downloads besides the HTML, brotli) and its islands with why each is one; `firstLoadUrls`, `distLocator` and `measureFirstLoad` from `@kayjs/kay/config` give a plugin the same figure for a page (`measureFirstLoad(urls, locate, htmlBytes, cacheable)` also returns `cached`, the bytes of the URLs `cacheable` accepts, such as the hashed `/_kay/` files a browser keeps for the next page), as the docs footer does; `--analyze --json` outputs `BundleReport` JSON on stdout without summary lines; `--max-js 40kb` fails on a route whose gzipped eager JS is over it, naming its eager islands), `kay start [dir] [--port 3000] [--host [addr]]`, `kay upgrade [dir] [--no-install]` (moves an app from bare `kay` imports to `@kayjs/kay` and `icons` to `@kayjs/icons/plugin`, and registers stateful plugins as their handles), plus plugin commands (`kay ui-eject <grammar> [dest]`, `kay mcp-footprint`, `kay i18n-check`, `kay icons-find <words> [--set <prefix>] [--limit <n>]`). `kay --help`, `kay <command> --help` and `kay --completions fish|bash|zsh` come from `@kaynooo/cli-kit`; a typo'd command or option names the one meant. Exit codes: 0 done, 1 a finding or failure (`kay check` found an error, `kay upgrade` has steps left by hand, a build failed), 2 a usage error (unknown command or option, bad port or `--max-js`). Plugin commands are read from `kay.config.ts` only when the first word is no built-in, and take `--root <dir>` and `--help`; a config that fails to load leaves `kay --help` and the built-ins working, and a plugin command typed then names the error (exit 1).
- **Testing (`@kayjs/kay/test`)**: `const app = await testApp({ root, prebuilt?, outDir? })` (builds into its own `.kay-cache/test-*` folder, removed at exit, never into `dist/`; `prebuilt: true` reuses the latest testApp build of that root in the process, else `dist/`) — in-process `app.get()`, `app.post()`, `app.import(path)` (the app's bundled copy of a route, action file or `kay.config.ts`), `app.submit(action | url, fields)`, `app.fetch()`, `app.cookies`, `app.clearCookies()` with persistent cookie jar and zero port binding; `app.errors` lists unhandled route/action/plugin errors (`route GET /p: message`), and `testApp({ dev: true })` shows them in the 500 like `kay dev` does. Unhandled errors with `dev` (kay dev, `dev: true`): `console.error` unless an `onError` hook exists, and the 500 carries message and stack, each frame at its `src/` file and line (under `kay start` too, through the source maps `kay build` writes; a `--compile` binary names its own code) (JSON `{ ok: false, status: 500, error, stack }` when the request wants JSON, else text; `_error.tsx` still renders); production stays `Internal Server Error`. `kay dev` build errors also answer JSON/text per `Accept`. Islands: `const b = await testBrowser({ root, timeout?, browserPath? })` (needs `playwright-core` as a dev dependency and Chrome/Chromium; production build served on `b.origin`, a free 127.0.0.1 port) then `const page = await b.open(path)` (resolves once the page has loaded and its `load`/`client` islands have hydrated; `visible`, `idle` and `interaction` ones are the test's to trigger) (`b.open(path, { reducedMotion: true })` opens it for a visitor asking for less motion) with `page.click(sel)`, `page.hover(sel)`, `page.fill(sel, value)`, `page.text(sel)`, `page.waitFor(sel | fn)`, `page.evaluate(fn)`, `page.errors` (page errors, console errors, 4xx/5xx responses), `page.close()`, and `await b.close()` at the end.
- **Plugins (`kay.config.ts`)**: `export default defineConfig({ plugins: [...] })` / `definePlugin(...)`. Order with `enforce: 'pre' | 'post'` and `after: ['@kayjs/i18n']` (a name no plugin has is an optional dependency, unless it is one typo from one that is, which fails). Two plugins sharing a `name` fail, and so does an unknown config key, naming the closest one.
  - A stateful plugin's `createX()` returns the plugin and the app's handle in one object: `plugins: [auth, mail, rooms]`, with `auth.guard()`, `mail.send()`, `rooms.publish()` in routes. Stateless plugins are `x()`.
  - Hooks: `server(api)` (`use(mw, { scope? })` (`'all'` default, prerendered pages included; `'rendered'` skips prerendered pages, for middleware that only feeds rendering such as a session; `'dynamic'` also skips pages with no `load`; or a path prefix), `rewrite` (also run once per prerendered page at start, on an anonymous GET: no side effects), `route(method, path, handler, { csrf?, trustedOrigins?, trustProxy? })` (responses get the security headers; an HTML one without its own CSP gets the app's, its `<style>` blocks hashed), `provide(key, value)`/`inject(key)` typed by `serviceKey<T>(name)` from `@kayjs/kay/config`, `getBuildData`), `onError(info)`, `build(ctx)` (`emitAsset`, `emitPublic`, `addStyle`, `addRouteStyle`, `addHead`, `addRouteHead`, `provide`, `inject`, `setData`, `routes`), `afterPrerender(ctx)` (`routes`, `publicFiles`, `emitAsset`, `emitPublic`, `setData`), `transform`, `bunPlugins` (array or `({ root, assetPrefix, minify, target }) => [...]`), `css`, `head(head, ctx)`, `transformHtml`, `prerenderPaths`, `clientEntry`, `check(ctx)`, `watchPaths`, `commands`.
  - Runtime state (timers, connections, caches) is created in `server(api)` and released in `api.onShutdown()`, never in the plugin factory (a throwing `onShutdown` or `onError` hook is logged with its plugin's name; the others still run): `kay dev` starts the next server on the same instance before shutting the last one down, and a new process on a `kay.config.ts` edit.
  - First-party packages (13 total with `@kayjs/kay`; each ships its full reference at `node_modules/@kayjs/<name>/llms.txt`):
    - `@kayjs/ui` (`node_modules/@kayjs/ui/llms.txt`): Zero-JS layout/form primitives (`Stack`, `Cluster`, `Grid`, `Sidebar`, `Split`, `Button`, `Card`, `Badge`, `Notice`, `Field`, `Switch`, `Checkbox`, `RadioGroup`, `Accordion`, `Popover`), island widgets (`Dialog`, `Drawer`, `Tabs`, `Menu`, `Select`, `CommandPalette`, `DataTable`, `Toaster` + `toast()`), `@layer kui` Style Grammars (`orbit`, `editorial`, `workshop`, `console`, `soft`, `bare`), `kay ui-eject`.
    - `@kayjs/auth` (`node_modules/@kayjs/auth/llms.txt`): Argon2id passwords, hashed sessions, email verification (`requireEmailVerification: true`), magic links, OAuth 2.0 + PKCE, `auth.guard()`, RGPD helpers (`listSessions`, `exportUser`, `deleteUser`), `memoryAuthStore()` & `sqliteAuthStore()`.
    - `@kayjs/content` (`node_modules/@kayjs/content/llms.txt`): Zero-dep `Bun.markdown` + `Bun.YAML` collections, Standard Schema frontmatter, lazy `entry.render()` (`highlight`, MDX-lite `components`, `headingLinks`), auto-wired `@kayjs/images`, localized collections, TOC, and RSS feeds (`content({ feeds })`).
    - `@kayjs/live` (`node_modules/@kayjs/live/llms.txt`): Typed SSE rooms (`createRooms()`), `publish()`, microtask `coalesce()`, `rooms.stream()`, and browser `useLive()` hook (`@kayjs/live/client`).
    - `@kayjs/mcp` (`node_modules/@kayjs/mcp/llms.txt`): MCP Streamable HTTP (`2025-03-26`) exposing `action()`/handlers & compacted Standard JSON Schemas at `/mcp/tools` with bearer auth, `schemas`/`schemaRef`, `resources`, `formatLines`/`formatTable`, `budget`, and `kay mcp-footprint`.
    - `@kayjs/images` (`node_modules/@kayjs/images/llms.txt`): Build-time AVIF/WebP pipeline + disk cache (`images()`, `image()`, `<Picture>`, `optimizeImageFile()`) and 1200×630 PNG OG `shareCard()`.
    - `@kayjs/seo` (`node_modules/@kayjs/seo/llms.txt`): `titleTemplate`, localized `description`, canonical URLs, OG/Twitter/`jsonLd()`, i18n-aware `sitemap.xml`, redirects, manifest, favicons, and self-hosted fonts.
    - `@kayjs/i18n` (`node_modules/@kayjs/i18n/llms.txt`): Locale URL rewriting (`ctx.locals.locale`/`t`/`localize`/`alternates`), `<html lang>` + internal link prefixing (`data-no-localize`), `prerenderPaths`, `hreflang`, `Intl` formatters, `kay i18n-check`.
    - `@kayjs/icons` (`node_modules/@kayjs/icons/llms.txt`): Virtual `~icons/<set>/<name>` & `src/icons` (`~icons/local/<name>`) inline SVG imports + accessible `<Icon>`, `icons()` from `@kayjs/icons/plugin`, `kay icons-find`, and server-only `@kayjs/icons/search`.
    - `@kayjs/mail` (`node_modules/@kayjs/mail/llms.txt`): `createMailer()`, `resend()` HTTP or custom transport, and dev-only `/_kay/mail` (+ `.json`) outbox preview.
    - `@kayjs/tailwind` (`node_modules/@kayjs/tailwind/llms.txt`): Tailwind v4 via `tailwind()` (auto-loads `bun-plugin-tailwind`, defaults `css: 'src/app.css'`).
    - `@kayjs/spa` (`node_modules/@kayjs/spa/llms.txt`): `regions()` (`refreshRegion()` from `@kayjs/spa/regions`) for `<Region>` swaps and opt-in `spa()` full-page navigation with `[data-persist]` islands and `[data-kay-prefetch]`.
- **Server builds & `--compile`**: `kay build` writes a stage folder beside `outDir` and renames it in only once every step (bundles, plugin hooks, prerender, `--compile`) passed, so a failed build leaves the previous `outDir` byte-identical and a running `kay start` keeps serving it; once a build lands, `kay start` loads it in-process with no restart (requests arriving meanwhile wait for it, plugin `server()` runs again and the old build's `api.onShutdown()` hooks run, a build that fails to load is logged and the old one keeps answering, a new port/host/`maxRequestBodySize` needs a restart), and a file it can no longer read answers `404` `no-store`; each build is marked with `.kay-output`, and a folder holding files kay did not build is refused by name (an empty one or an unmarked older kay build is replaced). Server `Bun.build` keeps npm dependencies external (`packages: 'external'`) while compiling `@kayjs/*` TSX packages; `kay build --compile` bundles everything + `public/` assets (`with { type: "file" }`) into one standalone Bun executable (`NODE_ENV` defaults to `production`). `kay start` and compiled binaries stop gracefully on `SIGTERM`/`SIGINT`/`SIGHUP`: no new connections, `api.onShutdown()` hooks run (`@kayjs/live` ends its streams), exit 0 once in-flight requests answer, exit 1 after 10 s.

## Canonical Snippets

### 1. Route with `load()`, `notFound()`, and `<Head>`

```tsx
// src/routes/posts/[slug].tsx
import type { PageProps, RouteContext } from '@kayjs/kay'
import { Head } from '@kayjs/kay'
import { notFound } from '@kayjs/kay/server'
import { getPost } from '../../db'

export async function load(ctx: RouteContext<'/posts/[slug]'>) {
  const post = await getPost(ctx.params.slug)
  if (!post) return notFound()
  return { post }
}

export default function PostPage({ data }: PageProps<typeof load>) {
  return (
    <article>
      <Head><title>{data.post.title}</title></Head>
      <h1>{data.post.title}</h1>
    </article>
  )
}
```

### 2. Automatic Island (`signal`, `computed`, `useId`)

```tsx
// src/components/Counter.tsx — becomes an island automatically (no directive)
import { computed, signal, useId } from '@kayjs/kay'

export function Counter({ initial = 0 }: { initial?: number }) {
  const count = signal(initial)
  const doubled = computed(() => count.value * 2)
  const id = useId('counter')
  return (
    <div id={id}>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => count.value++}>Count: {count.value}</button>
      <span> (x2: {doubled.value})</span>
    </div>
  )
}
```

### 3. Server Action & Progressive `useAction()` Form

```ts
// src/actions/subscribe.ts
import { action } from '@kayjs/kay/server'
import { z } from 'zod'

export const subscribe = action(z.object({ email: z.string().email() }), async ({ email }) => {
  return { subscribed: email }
})
```

```tsx
// src/components/SubscribeForm.tsx
import { useAction } from '@kayjs/kay'
import { subscribe } from '../actions/subscribe'

export function SubscribeForm() {
  const form = useAction(subscribe, { reset: true })
  return (
    <form action={form.action} method="post" onSubmit={form.onSubmit}>
      <input name="email" type="email" required />
      <button type="submit" disabled={form.pending.value}>Join</button>
      {form.fieldErrors.value.email && <p role="alert">{form.fieldErrors.value.email}</p>}
      {form.data.value && <p>Subscribed {form.data.value.subscribed}</p>}
    </form>
  )
}
```

### 4. Config (`kay.config.ts`) & In-Process Test (`@kayjs/kay/test`)

```ts
// kay.config.ts
import { defineConfig } from '@kayjs/kay/config'
import { seo } from '@kayjs/seo'
import { auth } from './src/auth'

export default defineConfig({
  site: 'https://example.com',
  plugins: [auth, seo({ name: 'Acme', titleTemplate: '%s | Acme' })],
})
```

```ts
// tests/app.test.ts
import { expect, test } from 'bun:test'
import { testApp } from '@kayjs/kay/test'

test('home renders', async () => {
  const app = await testApp({ root: '.' })
  const res = await app.get('/')
  expect(res.status).toBe(200)
})
```
